stem_book: [One or more options may be correct] For an ideal gas taken between the same two states at constant temperature (isothermal), select the correct statements. (a) The magnitude of work involved in an isothermal irreversible expansion is less than that involved in isothermal reversible expansion (b) Heat absorbed during isothermal reversible expansion is more than that in isothermal irreversible expansion (c) The magnitude of work involved in an isothermal reversible compression is more than that involved in isothermal irreversible compression (d) Heat released during isothermal irreversible compression is more than that in isothermal reversible compression
reason: Printed key 'abcd' includes (c), but reversible compression needs the MINIMUM work, so |w_rev| < |w_irr| and (c) is false. Print's 'intermediate' read as 'isothermal' (the only reading where q = −w comparisons hold) and (b)'s second 'reversible' corrected to 'irreversible'.
work: Isothermal ideal gas q = −w; expansion |w_rev| > |w_irr| ⇒ a,b true; compression |w_rev| < |w_irr| ⇒ c false, d true
